claim_checks.basis: Entire original2006essay printed9/PDF1 inspected. Barik associates Barunei/Karunei with the Bhoi dynasty and Khordha fort; article correctly names the two deities and ties the shrine to former royal history. No unsupported height, temple age or exact foundation date.

Capital at hill foot, paired deities as khetreswari of Khordha fort, and Paika worship are in the essay. Public paragraph explicitly attributes these to Pabitra Mohan Barik in2006. Protectors is a reasonable plain-language paraphrase of the fort’s guardian deities; no archaeological/archival verification is invented.

Original President’s Secretariat transcript opening connects Barunei foothills/IIT campus with1817Paika Bidroh and Bakshi Jagabandhu. Article reports2018recollection rather than presenting speech as contemporary1817evidence. It avoids first-war ranking or a precise battlefield assertion.

Original8December2019PIBrelease final paragraphs report foundation-stone laying at Barunei (source typo Baruei). Article explicitly says foundation stone, not completed/open memorial or current facilities.

Actual district Tourism page lists Barunei hill activity, Khordha Road Junction/Bhubaneswar airport and October–March. Draft explicitly calls these wider gateways and a district recommendation. No transfer of27km airport distance, two-day duration, live transport availability, trail safety/difficulty or opening hours.
